column1: # content/terminology-rules.tsv -- SXC-1 Trainer terminology linter rules (M2)
# Six TAB-separated columns, '#' comments and blank lines ignored:
#   rule_id  kind  phrases  replacement  glossary_anchor  message
# kind=forbid  none of the comma-separated phrases may appear in learner-facing
#              text (case-insensitive, word-bounded: not flanked by an ASCII
#              letter, digit or hyphen).
# kind=caseof  each phrase is a canonical on-device spelling; any
#              case-insensitive occurrence that is not byte-exact is an error.
# glossary_anchor must occur verbatim (a literal substring) in
# translations/glossary.md -- every rule here is traceable to the binding
# glossary, never invented house style. Parsed by SXC1.Exercise.Lint.parseRules;
# grounding checked by SXC1.Exercise.Lint.groundRules.
# Learner-facing text = deck title/summary, exercise titles, all body prose
# (including inline code spans), option labels, check: sentences, and
# Answer/Why/Hint blocks. EXCLUDED: id, deck, tags, verify:, and the quoted
# anchor inside cite:/find: lines.
term-register
column6: Use "assign" (or "store" when saving into memory) instead of "register" -- the glossary marks registered as a rejected translation of 登録する.

column1: term-machine
column6: Refer to the device as "this unit" (or "SXC-1"), never "this machine" or "this product".

column1: term-tap-pad
column3: hit the pad,hit a pad,strike the pad,press the pad
column6: Use "tap a pad" (or "tap pad <N>") -- the glossary fixes パッドを叩く as "tap a pad", not "hit/strike/press".

column1: term-sound-source
column6: Use "sound" for 音源 in exercise prose; "sound source" is reserved for input-source contexts (see the glossary's note on 音源).

column1: term-device-name
column6: The device name is spelled exactly "SXC-1".

column1: term-company
column6: The company name is spelled exactly "CASIO".

column1: term-app-name
column6: The companion app's name is spelled exactly "CASIO Sampler App", never translated or abbreviated.

column1: term-chapters
column3: Part: Preparation,Part: Pad play,Part: Sampling,Part: Sequencer,Part: Leveling up
column6: Chapter titles must match one of the five binding "Part: X" titles exactly, including capitalization and punctuation.

column1: term-screen-labels
column3: SELECT BANK,MASTER BPM,SOUND EDIT,AUTO TRIGGER,LOW STRAGE SPACE,ONE SHOT,INPUT VOL,MAIN VOL,LINE OUT,AUDIO IN,POWER/DATA,INPUT SELECT,Beat Sync,APO Time
column6: On-device and on-screen labels must be spelled exactly as printed on the SXC-1, including the device's own misspelling LOW STRAGE SPACE -- do not "correct" it.
